help.text: The programs are drawn in the editor: open it with the instance link (globe icon) or the address in info.editorUrl, e.g. http://<ioBroker-IP>:8097/

publicHost.label: Address of the ioBroker server for the link (optional)

accessKey.label: Access key (optional)
accessKey.help: If set, the editor must be opened with ?key=... (anybody who can open the editor can switch data points)
